summary: This note describes Corson, an unincorporated community in Brandon Township, Minnehaha County, South Dakota, with a population of 70. It sits just north of Interstate 90 and near Brandon on South Dakota Highway 11. The community was once mainly a railroad and farming town but is becoming an industrial area serving the county. Sioux Falls lies about twelve miles west-southwest of it.
one_line: Corson is a small unincorporated community in Minnehaha County, South Dakota, shifting from railroad and farming to industry.
